gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Expose crams its lowercase right up against the capitals, leaving almost no pause between letters. And Noto Sans Bassa Vah does the opposite job, its big midsection and open-jawed c giving the text a sturdy, sans-serif plainness.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-batak: Tight, tall and striking. Expose packs its lines with barely a breath, so Noto Sans Batak, with its towering x-height and an open e, is worth setting a notch smaller beneath it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and leaves every letter mouth distinctly open, a friendly contrast to Expose above. Long paragraphs would read smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Compressed and sharp, with a refined swagger. Expose handles the attention-grabbing, while the next line, Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, offers swollen, tightly coiled lowercase and open apertures that make the sans-serif text easy to settle into.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi sits its mean line high and leaves curves open-ended. Under Expose, a display face with barely any gap between x-height and caps, the body could run a touch larger.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Striking is the first word for Expose, which compresses its cadence until hardly a pause remains. And Noto Sans Buginese gives the sans-serif text open letter mouths and short ascenders, a modern, unhurried counterweight.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, with a high-set x-height, while Expose above it stays tightly compressed and refined. A long passage would feel unhurried.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-carian: Expose is striking and refined, with almost no gap between x-height and caps. Noto Sans Carian keeps terminals apart like open scissor blades, so a long passage would read cleanly and lightly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Barely any gap separates Expose's lowercase from its capitals, giving a compressed, striking cadence. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase high too, yet its uncrowded s and c keep long reading comfortable.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-cham: Compressed, striking and refined: that is Expose, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Noto Sans Cham brings open c shapes and tall rounded forms, so longer text feels modern and unhurried.
